name: napkin
description: A Codex-native editable spreadsheet surface for thread-scoped calculations.

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex calculations in an editable sheet.
interface.longDescription: Napkin gives Codex a thread-scoped spreadsheet it can open in the in-app browser and read through MCP. It keeps lightweight calculations visible, treats user edits as the source of truth, and asks before changing edited cells.
defaultPrompt: Open a Napkin sheet for this calculation.
Read my sheet edits and update the calculations.
Put this analysis into an editable spreadsheet.
